video.description:
Learn to read and explain basic async/await code: Async Function, Await & Suspension Point, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Async Function - A function marked `async` that can pause while it waits for a result.
Await - A keyword that marks where an `async` call may pause until its result is ready.
Suspension Point - A place in `async` code where the function may pause and let other work run.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Async Function, Await & Suspension Point in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Async Function, Await, Suspension Point 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Async Function - A function marked `async` that can pause while it waits for a result.
한국어: Async Function: 결과를 기다리는 동안 일시 중지될 수 있도록 async로 표시한 함수

Await - A keyword that marks where an `async` call may pause until its result is ready.
한국어: Await: async 호출이 결과가 준비될 때까지 멈출 수 있는 지점을 표시하는 키워드

Suspension Point - A place in `async` code where the function may pause and let other work run.
한국어: Suspension Point: async 코드에서 함수가 멈추고 다른 작업이 실행될 수 있는 지점

landscape.hook: Can you explain Async Function, Await and Suspension Point in English?

dialogue.title: The missing await
dialogue.setting: A call that Xcode will not accept

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, Xcode gives me an error when I call `fetchName`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Is it an async function? In your code it is marked with `async`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: An async function can pause while it waits for a result.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So how do I call it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You need await before the call. Await marks where the call may pause.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where does the code actually pause?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: At each suspension point. Here it is the line with await.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the app freeze at a suspension point?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. The function pauses, but other work can run in the meantime.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That is clever. So every await is a suspension point?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and every async function needs await to be called.
Mark the function as an async function.
